name: Liquidity Flow Connectivity Obfuscation
description: I replaced the textbook definition of a connected graph (partitioning into two disjoint sets bridged by an edge) with a mathematically equivalent financial flow condition: the ability to resolve any arbitrary zero-sum distribution of balances. This forces models to reason from first principles about what kind of structure allows universal zero-sum routing (a connected component), breaking their pattern-matching for Steiner Tree and likely causing them to misclassify the problem as a network flow or matching task.
